home.heroSubtitle: NAAC Accredited 'B++' Grade | Affiliated to University of Rajasthan
home.aboutText: Government Smt. Saraswati Girls Senior Secondary School and College, Chirawa, established in 1987, is a premier women's college dedicated to providing quality higher education in rural Rajasthan.
home.whyChooseSubtitle: Excellence in education, empowerment through knowledge
home.whyReason1Text: Since the 1980s, there was a lack of quality higher education for women, which we have addressed.
home.whyReason2Text: Experienced and dedicated teachers committed to the success and holistic development of students.
home.whyReason3Text: Providing appropriate environment and training for the all-round development of students.
home.whyReason4Text: Safe and supportive environment that gives utmost priority to student safety.
home.whyReason5Text: Committed to bringing change in society through women's empowerment and higher education.
home.whyReason6Text: B++ Grade accreditation recognizing our commitment to educational excellence and quality.
